svg.title: telegram-message-exporter
svg.desc: Chat recovery. Recovers deleted chats from the encrypted cache Telegram for macOS keeps on disk, entirely offline. Built in: Python, with SQLCipher. Exports: HTML, Markdown and CSV. Install: pip install git+https://github.com/soakes/telegram-message-exporter, then telegram-exporter discover --root recovery/telegram.
svg.text: Recovers deleted chats from the encrypted cache Telegram for
macOS keeps on disk, entirely offline.
